item.title: Trump says Iran war could be over soon, but oil disruption would trigger harsher US strikes
item.description: DUBAI, United Arab Emirates (AP) — U.S. President Donald Trump said Monday that the war against Iran could be short-lived, but he left open the possibility of an escalation in fighting if global oil supplies are disrupted by the Islamic Republic, which chose a new hard-line supreme leader. item.title: Peoria gas prices jump 43 cents amid Iran conflict tensions
item.description: Gas prices in the Peoria area rose 43.4 cents last week, driven by the ongoing war against Iran, with the average price of gas now at $3.38 a gallon.

item.title: One person is dead after a duplex fire in Washington
item.description: One person died after a fire broke out in a duplex in Washington, Illinois early Monday morning, with the cause of the fire still under investigation.

item.title: Peoria sheriff alerts public to pre-trial services scam
item.description: The Peoria County Sheriff's Office is warning the public of a scam targeting families of recently arrested people, where scammers claim to be from "Pre-Trial Services" and demand money for early release.

item.title: Bloomington asking residents for input on Miller Park master plan
item.description: The City of Bloomington is seeking community input on potential improvements and future development of Miller Park through the Miller Park Master Plan survey.

item.title: Tazewell County Sheriff's Office warns of DMV scam
item.description: The Tazewell County Sheriff's Office is warning the public of scammers impersonating the Illinois Department of Motor Vehicles, who are sending text messages demanding payment for unpaid fines and threatening to suspend licenses or registrations.

item.title: CxT Roasting Company opening new location in East Peoria
item.description: CxT Roasting Company is expanding to East Peoria with a new store in the Blutowne apartment complex, offering quality coffee and education to the local community.

item.title: Sophomore dies after tragic baseball head injury incident
item.description: Bentley Wolfe, 15, of Chrisman, died from detrimental head trauma after being hit in the head by a line drive baseball during baseball practice on March 2.

item.title: Data Center no longer coming to Pekin
item.description: Mayor Mary Burress announced that the City of Pekin will not move forward with the proposed data center project due to concerns from residents about noise pollution and electricity prices.

item.title: W.E. Sullivan's Irish Pub in Peoria Heights to close, new site to be announced
item.description: W.E. Sullivans Irish Pub and Fare in Peoria Heights will be closing its doors on April 18, and a new location has not been announced yet.
